create.name: Swami Sukhabodhananda
create.bio:
Swami Sukhabodhananda is a Vedanta teacher based in Bengaluru, the city where he was born in 1955. As a young man he went to Sandeepany Sadhanalaya in Mumbai to study under Swami Chinmayananda, who sent him out to teach the Upanishads and the Bhagavad Gita. He went on to found Prasanna Trust in Bengaluru, which runs his teaching alongside schools support and food programmes, and he has written well over a hundred short books in English and several Indian languages, from commentaries on the Gita and Bhaja Govindam to his popular 'Relax Please' series.

His style is practical rather than devotional: he asks students to test the teachings against their own experience instead of taking them on faith, and he often draws on business and sporting examples, having coached company leaders and an IPL cricket side. He gives free public Gita talks in Indian cities, leads retreats near Bengaluru, and teaches online through live morning sessions and a fortnightly study circle. Online festival programmes for Navaratri, Shivaratri and Guru Purnima bring meditation and scripture study together.

courses.title: Prasanna Esoteric Club (PEC)
courses.description: A live online study circle with Swamiji, meeting for ninety minutes on alternate Tuesdays. Sessions look at how thought, emotion and habit work and how plain observation changes them, without asking for belief or set rituals; fees also support Prasanna Trust's food programme.

courses.title: Spiritual Morning Retreat – Awaken Clarity & Inner Strength
courses.description: An online morning programme mixing recorded sessions with live classes led by Swamiji. Each session includes guided meditation and practical teaching on relationships, money and inner life, aimed at starting the day with a settled mind.

courses.title: CXO 1-on-1 with Swami Sukhabodhananda
courses.description: Weekly early-morning Friday sessions for company leaders, applying Vedantic ideas to decision-making and steadiness at work. Recordings stay available to members.

courses.title: Effective Living Through Bhagavad Gita with Swami Sukhabodhananda Ji
courses.description: A free evening discourse in Navi Mumbai on putting the Gita's teaching into daily practice, part of a public Gita lecture series. All are welcome; registration is through the event page.
